hints.title: Obstacle Gaps
hints.text: Placing a block of size sz within [0, x] requires either a gap between consecutive obstacles of size at least sz, or a space between the last obstacle before x and x of at least sz.

hints.title: Point Updates in Segment Tree
hints.text: Maintain the max gap ending at each obstacle index using a segment tree over coordinate space.

hints.title: Range Query
hints.text: For query [2, x, sz], query the segment tree for max gap in [0, p] where p is the predecessor obstacle of x, and check x - p >= sz.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Segment tree point updates and range maximum queries take O(log M).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning obstacle gaps on each query takes O(q^2) causing time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M) tree storage enables logarithmic query response.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the dynamic interval gap query structure and implement range max segment tree.
